description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling FeaturePropertiesDeleted events within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically deleting feature properties from a ThingBuilder when such events occur.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a strategy to handle FeaturePropertiesDeleted events by removing feature properties from a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies the FeaturePropertiesDeleted event to a ThingBuilder, removing the specified feature properties.
